title: 第21章 哪个才是面具第22章 前奏
content_zh:
;;
“啪！”
希琳公主一拍桌面，猛地从学院会客室的椅子上站起来：“明天的誓约决斗，父皇他也会来？”
前来传讯的宫廷内侍微微躬身，姿态恭敬却语气肯定：“是的，公主殿下。
而且不止是皇帝陛下，北境大公赫曼阁下，届时也会一并到场观战。”
他顿了顿，抬眼小心翼翼地观察了一下希琳的脸色，补充道：“所以还请殿下能认真对待此事。”
“认真对待？”
希琳几乎要被气笑了，她强压着心头翻涌的莫名烦躁：“我向来对任何事都很认真，尤其是这场决斗！”
内侍不敢多言，再次行礼后便悄无声息地退出了会客室。
沉重的木门轻轻合拢，室内重新恢复了寂静。
希琳却无法平静。
皇帝和北境大公亲自前来观战？
有什么意义吗？
不过是场普通决斗……好吧并不普通。
这场决斗背后的意义，关乎皇室与北境联姻的走向。
可决斗的过程本身……有什么看点吗？
这本身就是一场毫无悬念甚至可称乏味的一个过场而已，对于自己的实力，她有一个清晰的认知，对付克洛伊那种徒有虚表的纨绔草包，她一个照面就能解决。
两位屹立于帝国权力与力量顶点的存在，难道就为了看这转瞬即逝的一幕，特意抽出时间前来？怕是前脚刚落座，后脚就得起身离开吧？
这背后，究竟是什么意思？是父皇对解除婚约仍有顾虑？还是那位北境大公，对他那个不成器的儿子，突然产生了某种她无法理解的期待？
纷乱的思绪如同纠缠的丝线，理不出头绪。

“……算了。”
希琳摒弃诸般杂念，深吸了一口气，冰蓝色的眼眸中重新凝聚起决断。
无论如何，得先去告诉那个家伙一声。
至少，得让他明白明天的场合何等严肃，别再抱有任何蒙混过关或者临阵耍赖的侥幸心理。
她推开会客室的门，快步走入学院午间熙攘的人流中。
阳光正好，学生们三三两两，谈笑声不绝于耳，她随即拦住几个相熟或面生的学生，询问克洛伊的踪迹。
大多数人都摇头表示不知，直到她遇到一个脸上带着怪异表情的女生。
那女生在听到“克洛伊”
的名字时，眼神闪烁了一下，似乎想笑又强行忍住，最后抬手指向了学院食堂的方向。
希琳道谢后，便朝着食堂走去。
皇家魔法学院的食堂依旧宽敞明亮，充斥着食物香气与嘈杂人声。
然而，希琳一踏入大门，就敏锐地察觉到一股异样的氛围。
许多人的目光，或明或暗，都投向同一个角落。
窃窃私语声中夹杂着低低的哄笑和惊叹。
希琳顺着那些视线望去——
只见在那个靠窗的座位上，食物几乎堆成了小山。
烤得焦香流油的兽腿、堆叠如塔的肉排、淋满酱汁的面条、金黄酥脆的馅饼……而在这座“山”

"Crack!"
Princess Shireen slapped the table and suddenly stood up from the chair in the college's reception room: "Tomorrow's oath duel, will my father also come?"
The palace servant who came to convey the message bowed slightly, his posture was respectful but his tone was affirmative: "Yes, Your Royal Highness.
And not only His Majesty the Emperor, but His Excellency Hermann, the Grand Duke of the North, will also be present to watch the battle. "
He paused, raised his eyes and carefully observed Shirin's face, and added: "So please, Your Highness, take this matter seriously."
"Take it seriously?"
Shireen almost laughed out of anger. She suppressed the inexplicable irritation in her heart: "I have always been serious about everything, especially this duel!"
The chamberlain did not dare to say anything, and after bowing again, he quietly exited the reception room.
The heavy wooden door closed gently, and silence returned to the room.
Shireen couldn't calm down.
The emperor and the Northern Duke came to watch the battle in person?
What's the point?
It was just an ordinary duel... well, not ordinary.
The meaning behind this duel is related to the direction of the marriage between the royal family and the North.
But the duel process itself... is there anything interesting to watch?
This in itself is just a scene that has no suspense and can even be called boring. She has a clear understanding of her own strength. She can deal with Chloe, a dandy with nothing but appearances, in one face to face.
Did these two beings, who stood at the pinnacle of the empire's power and power, take the time to come here just to see this fleeting scene? I'm afraid that as soon as the front foot is seated, the back foot will have to get up and leave, right?
What is the meaning behind this? Is it because the father still has concerns about breaking off the engagement? Or did the Grand Duke of the North suddenly have some expectations for his incompetent son that she couldn't understand?
The chaotic thoughts are like tangled threads, and there is no clue.
"...Forget it."
Shirin abandoned all distracting thoughts, took a deep breath, and regained determination in her ice-blue eyes.
No matter what, you have to tell that guy first.
At least, let him understand how serious the occasion tomorrow is, and stop having any chance of getting through or cheating.
She pushed open the door of the reception room and walked quickly into the bustling crowd of people in the college at noon.
The sun was just right, and the students were in twos and threes, chatting and laughing. She immediately stopped a few familiar or unfamiliar students and asked about Chloe's whereabouts.
Most people shook their heads to express ignorance, until she met a girl with a strange expression on her face.
The girl is hearing "Chloe"
When he heard his name, his eyes flickered, as if he wanted to laugh but suppressed it, and finally raised his hand and pointed in the direction of the college cafeteria.
Shirin thanked her and walked towards the cafeteria.
The cafeteria of the Royal Academy of Magic is still spacious and bright, filled with the aroma of food and the noise of people.
However, as soon as Shirin stepped into the door, she was keenly aware of a strange atmosphere.
Many people's eyes, bright or dark, are directed to the same corner.
The whispers were mixed with low laughter and exclamations.
Shireen looked along those lines of sight——
I saw that there was almost a mountain of food on the window seat.
Roasted animal legs with a fragrant aroma, stacked steaks, noodles covered in sauce, golden and crispy pies... And in this "mountain"
